accounts.prose: This entry is a two-name façade: it performs no computation itself, but re-exports `normalize` and `nextSequence` from separate implementation modules. Those exports have unlike semantics—bounded numeric clamping versus a mutable sequence counter—so they should not be assigned a stronger common responsibility merely because they share an entry point. The nearby README calls the API pure and stateless and says repeated arguments give repeated results; that is true of `normalize`, but contradicted by `nextSequence`, whose module-scoped value is incremented on every call.
